atoms.b: Dolly opened up her doughnut shop just before the turn of the century. Back then, she was only able to offer a mere 4 flavours. With time, ((++18 -_18)) other flavours were added to the assortment. The first Friday in June each year was always the busiest day. Dolly would always experience a surge of customers, with over ((++500 -_500)) more visiting her shop than usual. On this day, her customers could save ((++1 -_1)) pound on each doughnut.

atoms.text: Dolly could still remember the day she stood in front of her newly acquired doughnut shop. That had been 18 years ago from today. Dolly was always open to trying out new approaches for her doughnut dough. She eventually came to realize that either a sugar glaze, sprinkles or powdered sugar made her doughnuts sweet enough. So, she decided to drastically reduce the amount of white sugar per batch by 250 grams. Therefore, she added her secret ingredients: 130 grams of stevia and 100 grams of applesauce. After receiving positive feedback, she decided to use this recipe for all her doughnuts.
